note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/E0412001/cash-bids?units=us — the site id E0412001 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://www.westfieldgrain.com/cashbids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (24293) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. One run said exact (5 testable rows, margin 5) and there is no second run to agree with it. A mode is a property of how they compute their board, so it needs the same answer on a different day's prices. Left off, the identity guard stays exact and a board that does not reconcile refuses loudly instead of publishing under a mode nobody established. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 5 row(s) for this location. The feed calls this location "Westfield", which is the company's name, not a town; location is set to Cortland. WHERE EACH FIELD CAME FROM: the street "4193 Everett Hull Road" and town "Cortland" are the operator's own Squarespace map block on that page (addressTitle "Westfield Specialty Grains"), which states no state or ZIP. State OH and ZIP 44410 are from the owner-approved request (Westfield Specialty Grains LLC, Cortland, OH 44410), and the page's own map marker (41.3361544, -80.6685073) lies in Trumbull County, Ohio, which agrees. COORDINATE is that operator-placed map marker, not a geocode and not a town centroid; it has not been checked against an independent geocoder. Phone and website are the business's own, from the Contact Us block on the same page. NOT ENABLED: the only run so far balances under every rounding rule (5 rows, residuals 0c), so no cashRounding can be stated, and every enabled dtn-cs source carries one. Run dtn-probe again on another day with this run's VERDICTS line (V E0412001 24293 exact 5 5) as `against`, rebuild with --against, and enable once a mode is stated.
